summary: The main article describes a photoinduced transition-metal-free alkynylation of alkyl pinacol boronates using 4CzIPN as a photocatalyst. It includes 6 schemes and 1 table detailing optimization, substrate scope for primary, secondary, and tertiary boronates, and mechanistic studies.

items.caption: (a and b) Photoinduced generation of alkyl radicals from alkyl-Bpin and its application in a transitionmetal-free alkynylation. LG = -SO2Ph. FG = aryl or amino groups. LG, leaving group; FG, functional group.
items.description: Comparison of previous photocatalytic activation methods for alkyl-Bpin versus the current transition-metal-free alkynylation strategy.
